NDT ERP software for Pennsylvania inspection companies

A Pennsylvania NDT company needs an ERP that can manage very different work across a large state: nuclear outages in the east and centre, gas gathering and processing in the Marcellus and Utica regions, petrochemical and steel work around Pittsburgh, refining and industrial work in the Philadelphia area, and a steady base of boiler, pressure vessel and fabrication inspection everywhere in between. The Atlantis ERP solution runs all of it from one system, with technician certification tracking, calibration management, crew dispatch, method-specific NDT reports, procedure control, quoting and invoicing built around the job record.

The overview above describes the platform in general terms. This section gets specific: how the Atlantis ERP handles the way Pennsylvania inspection work is actually won, staffed, documented and billed, what is built in, and what is configured during implementation. It is written for owners, operations managers, QA/QC managers and Level IIIs at small and mid-sized NDT companies who want one place to answer the questions every client audit asks.

If you want to see it on your own data first, request a Pennsylvania-focused demo. Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with a quote on request.

Pennsylvania is three or four inspection markets in one state

Pennsylvania's industrial map is spread out, and an NDT company here usually specialises by region or runs separate crews for each. In the southwest, Beaver County is home to the Shell Polymers Monaca petrochemical complex, which Shell has said it is exploring strategic and partnership options for, alongside steel making in the Mon Valley and the gas processing and pipeline infrastructure that serves the Marcellus and Utica shale. In the northeast, the Marcellus gas fields in counties such as Susquehanna and Bradford generate well site, gathering and compression work. In the southeast, the Philadelphia area has refining, chemicals, pharmaceuticals and heavy manufacturing. And the state's nuclear stations, including Beaver Valley, Susquehanna, Limerick and Peach Bottom, create outage work that draws technicians from across the region.

Each market has its own clients, codes, report formats and rhythms. Gas work tends to be steady and spread over long distances. Nuclear work comes in intense outage windows with strict access requirements. Petrochemical and refinery work spikes around turnarounds. Fabrication and boiler work is steady and local. In the Atlantis ERP each project carries an NDT job type, site, client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria, with assigned technicians and equipment and the safety induction and work permit fields that plants require. Cost centres let you run each region or line of work as its own profit centre and compare them on the financial dashboard.

  • Nuclear outages: tight qualification records, radiation safety training and badge tracking.
  • Gas gathering and processing: distributed sites, long drive times, steady volume.
  • Petrochemical, steel and refining: turnaround spikes and multi-method jobs.
  • Boiler, pressure vessel and fabrication shops: frequent, short, local jobs with repeat customers.

Crane Clean Energy Center and nuclear work in the state

Constellation is restarting the former Three Mile Island Unit 1, an 837 MW pressurised water reactor near Middletown now named the Crane Clean Energy Center, with operations expected in 2027 under a long-term power purchase agreement with Microsoft. Constellation has reported inspections of key systems, including the diesel generators, steam generator, main generator and turbines, as part of that work. A restart on this scale, alongside regular outages at the state's operating nuclear stations, keeps demand for qualified NDT technicians high in central and eastern Pennsylvania.

Nuclear clients are exacting about personnel records. The Atlantis ERP stores each technician's certificates by scheme, level, method, certifying body and sector, and the employee NDT profile adds radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. Certificate templates per scheme record validity, vision and exam requirements and minimum OJT and training hours, so the evidence that a technician met your written practice is on file, not in a folder at the office. When a nuclear client's access coordinator asks for a package on every technician you are sending, you produce it from the system.

Technician certification tracking software for Pennsylvania crews

Every certification in the Atlantis ERP is a record with its scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level from trainee to Level III, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam result and attachments. Status is calculated automatically as active, expiring soon (within 90 days), expired or revoked, and Expiring Soon and Expired menus are ready without any filtering.

Vision tests record near vision (Jaeger J1 or J2), far vision, colour perception and contrast, with examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry. Examination sheets store general, specific and practical scores against a passing score that defaults to 70 percent. Daily checks raise warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, and configurable email alerts go to the recipients you choose, with look-ahead days and resend intervals you set. The same alerts can cover calibration certificates and company certifications.

Timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid, which catches the problem when hours are logged instead of when a client rejects the report. For a company with crews spread from Erie to Philadelphia, that is the difference between fixing a lapse on Tuesday and explaining it to a client auditor a month later.

Calibration management software for a statewide equipment pool

A statewide NDT company usually has instruments in several trucks and yards at once, and the question of where a particular flaw detector is, and whether it is in calibration, is harder than it sounds. Asset Management tracks every instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number with equipment type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories, lifecycle state (new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired, disposed), calibration frequency and status.

Equipment is issued and returned through a workflow with supervisor and manager approval and condition recorded both ways. Reservations stop two crews booking the same serial, inbound and outbound movements are logged, and dispatch warns when assigned equipment is out of calibration. The maintenance log records preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement work with condition before and after.

Calibration records carry provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result and next due date, and the calibration certificate register holds the lab accreditation number, valid, expiring or expired status, PDF and alerts. Purchase records classify vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab, store the accredited-lab flag with accreditation number and expiry, and link order lines to the specific serial. Consumables including penetrant, developer, magnetic particle media, couplant and PPE have reorder levels and low-stock flags, so a crew in the northern tier does not discover it is out of developer two hours from the nearest supplier.

Boiler and pressure vessel work under Pennsylvania rules

Pennsylvania's Boiler and Unfired Pressure Vessel Law requires Department of Labor and Industry approval for installing or moving boilers and unfired pressure vessels, periodic inspection, and state credentials for the people who inspect them. Periodic inspections are carried out by the Department's Boiler Division or by commissioned inspectors, typically employed by insurers or by owner-user programmes. NDT contractors often support that work, performing UT thickness, MT, PT, VT or RT for the commissioned inspector who makes the call.

The Atlantis ERP is built for that relationship. Every report has fields for the third-party or authorized inspector's name and signature alongside your own inspector, reviewer and approver signatures. Reports record work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers and procedure and standard references, so the commissioned inspector sees exactly what was done, by whom, to which procedure revision, with which calibrated instrument. The ERP does not calculate inspection due dates for client equipment; it documents your NDT work cleanly for the people who do. For owners needing inspection programmes, Atlantis NDT offers API 510, 570 and 653 inspection services separately.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software across a large state

Team Assignments runs dispatch from planned to dispatched to in field to submitted to closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates on each job, in calendar, kanban or list view. The technician availability calendar records assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable entries and blocks overlaps. Double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers is blocked. For each technician you see status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date.

That view matters most when outage season stacks up: a nuclear outage, a petrochemical turnaround and a run of gas-plant work all wanting the same Level II UT techs in the same fortnight. Time Off feeds the same calendar, and Fleet records vehicle purpose, whether a vehicle can carry radioactive sources, the transport licence number and expiry, and assignments to project and driver with dates and mileage.

Timesheets capture work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client, equipment serial and approval. Long drives between Pennsylvania job sites make travel a real cost, and recording it by type on the day lets you bill it where the contract allows and see its true cost where it does not. Expenses captures per diems and field costs, which can be re-billed to the job.

NDT reporting software with 17 report types and an offline app

The reporting app in the Atlantis ERP shares its engine with the standalone Digital Twin Reporting Software and covers 17 report types with their own numbering sequences: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography. Fields are method-specific: UT probe calibration tables, RT source, technique, IQI type and placement, MT technique and particle type, PT method and developer, PAUT focal laws, MFL scan mode and item lines, UT thickness readings by direction, and weld and job lines with defect type and orientation. Every report closes with acceptable, not acceptable, or acceptable with remarks.

Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent. Company templates are versioned in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML with your logo and headers, and Excel templates fill automatically by mapping fields to cells. The offline field app installs as a web app and works in rural gas country and inside plant structures without signal, storing drafts and photos locally, capturing an on-screen signature, previewing the PDF and syncing later.

Procedure control with revision snapshots

The Procedures app holds a register with document number, revision, method (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, PAUT, LT, AE, hardness, PMI, CR, DR and more), scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria, and body text or an uploaded file. Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states, recorded rejection reasons, dated prepared, reviewed and approved-by fields, locked approved revisions and a snapshot of every revision. Approvers get email notifications and reminders. An AI-assisted first draft speeds up new procedures and falls back to a built-in template; a Level III reviews and approves before use.

NDT quoting and invoicing software

Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products flagged with method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF; clients accept and sign online and the quote converts to a sales order. Invoices carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables, and lines recording cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Billable timesheet hours and rate multipliers feed billing, and Pennsylvania taxes, payments and reminders are configured during implementation. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over 12 months. Request a quote for your team.

Integrations and the rest of the stack

The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue for return. The CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector and estimated technicians and days with a 0 to 100 lead score, and business cards can be photographed straight into leads. Asset owners can view inspection data in 3D with Atlantis Digital Twins, trainees can practise on the Practical NDT 3D simulator, and every module is on the ERP apps page, including procedures and fleet.

Implementation starts with technicians, certificates and instruments, then dispatch, reporting, procedures and billing, with integrations last. Atlantis NDT founder Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III, reviews the NDT configuration. Book a scoping call.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT ERP for small NDT companies in Pennsylvania?

The best fit is one affordable, fully customizable system that joins certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports and invoicing. The Atlantis ERP solution does that and is quoted on request.

Can it prepare technician records for nuclear outage access?

Yes. Certificates, vision tests, exam scores, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry are all on each technician's record.

Can we run separate regions as separate profit centres?

Yes. Cost centres on projects and invoices feed the financial dashboard, so each region or line of work can be compared.

Does the report support a commissioned inspector's signature?

Yes. Reports include third-party or authorized inspector name and signature fields alongside your own signatures.

Does the field app work without cell coverage?

Yes. Drafts, photos and signatures are stored locally and sync when the device reconnects.

Can it connect to QuickBooks or SAP?

Yes. The open REST API integrates with QuickBooks, SAP, NetSuite, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped during implementation.

Does Atlantis offer technician training?

Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, and the ERP records any other certificates your technicians hold.
